answer:
Mission Local reported that department chairs told lecturers to expect class cuts beginning in spring, sometimes eliminating classes entirely. The number of affected lecturers was unknown, but the university budget presentation suggested cuts equivalent to 125 full-time positions. It also outlined 23 full-time-equivalent tenure-track faculty cuts and six staff cuts; lecturers faced the largest reductions, about 30% in most colleges.

The article’s correction clarified that SF State was 16% below its target enrollment—not that enrollment had dropped 16%.
